Method Detail

Chain

public static DbProfile Chain(DbCurve seedCurve,
                              boolean associate,
                              double gapTol)
Creates a profile containing an ordered sequence of curves that are adjacent to the given seed curve within the given gap tolerance. When the end points of adjacent curves are within system tolerance, and associate is true, the adjacent curves will be forced to share a common end point.
Returns:
the profile that was created.

Trim

public static Point Trim(DbCurve curveA,
                         boolean endA,
                         DbCurve curveB,
                         boolean endB)
Trims two bounded curves to their common intersection point.
Parameters:
curveA - the first curve to consider
endA - (true) trims the end of the curve back to the intersection point / (false) trims the start of the curve back to the intersection point.
curveB - the second curve to consider
endB - (true) trims the end of the curve back to the intersection point / (false) trims the start of the curve back to the intersection point.
Returns:
(null) indicates failure / (else) the intersection as a geometric point.

Blend

public static DbArc Blend(DbCurve curveA,
                          DbCurve curveB,
                          double radius,
                          int dir,
                          double tol)
Inserts a blend radius between two 'adjacent' curves whose end points are within a given tolerance of each other. This is particularly useful for curve entities that are known to to touch each other, as in profiles.
Parameters:
curveA - the first curve to consider
curveB - the second curve to consider
radius - the required radius of the blending arc
dir - the required direction of the blending arc
tol - the tolerance with which to determine the adjacency of the ends of the given curves
Returns:
(null) indicates failure / (else) the resulting blending arc entity

LeadsAdd

public static boolean LeadsAdd(DbCurve dbCurve,
                               int style,
                               int combin,
                               int side,
                               double angle,
                               double length,
                               double radius)
Adds a lead-in and/or lead-out to a curve (or its parent profile).
Parameters:
style - one of Editor.LINE, Editor.ARC, Editor.LINE_ARC
combin - one of Editor.IN, Editor.OUT, Editor.IN_OUT
side - Const.LEFT or Const.RIGHT
angle - angle of line, or included angle of arc (degrees)
length - line length (ignored when not applicable to style)
radius - arc radius (ignored when not applicable to style)

Mirror

public static boolean Mirror(double xs,
                             double ys,
                             boolean aboutY,
                             boolean copy)
Mirrors all entities in the selection set about either a vertical or horizontal line. Note, in order to move or copy toolpath, it must be disassociated from its reference geometry. See also Weng.Modeler.Selector
Parameters:
xs - the X origin of the mirror axis
ys - the Y origin of the mirror axis
aboutY - (true) mirror about a vertical line / (false) mirror about a horizontal line
copy - (true) creates a copy / (false) moves the selected entities
